name: Opquast Checklist
description: A Checklist API checklist of Opquast web-quality best practices.
project_description:
The Opquast Checklist V4 module aims to improve the quality of online services through open-licensed checklists (Creative Commons BY-SA) and tools validated and used by a large community of web professionals. This module offers a set of 240 rules categorized by theme, helping you enhance the accessibility, performance, and security of your websites.

 The rules are organized into the following categories:

 
 Alternatives 
 Code 
 Contact Information 
 Contents 
 E-Commerce 
 Public Spaces 
 Files and Multimedia 
 Forms 
 Hyperlinks 
 Identification 
 Internationalization 
 Mobile 
 Navigation 
 Newsletter 
 Presentation 
 Security and Confidentiality 
 Server and Performance 
 Syndication 
 Tables 
 
 This module is an excellent way to implement best practices for high-quality web development , adhering to widely recognized industry standards.

 Discover more and join the Opquast community at Opquast 

 
 Dependencies 
 The module requires the Checklist API .

 
 
 Installation & Usage 
 
 The Opquast checklist is installed in the usual way. 
 See Installing contributed modules . 
 To start using the module, go to Reports > Checklists > Opquast Checklist or admin/reports/checklistapi/opquast . 
 From this page you can check the good practices you have implemented on your project. Remember to save your progress before leaving the page. 
 
 
 
 Recommended modules 
 No specific recommendations, you can use this module as is.

 
 
 Roadmap 
 This module is minimally maintained. It will be updated if needed but no further development is planned.

 
 
 More information 
 
 The module is available in English and French versions. 
 Possibility to hide or show objectives 
 Don't understand a rule or don't know how to implement it? No problem click on its link, you will be redirected to Opquast website where you will find all the information you need to set it up. 
 Opquast website : https://www.opquast.com/
